title: DevsTree — Technology, made approachable.
summary: A technology-services website that brings a broad offering into one clear, confident brand story.
idea: Help prospective partners understand the company’s technology offering and find a clear route to exploring the work or starting a conversation.
direction: A sculptural robotic-hand hero establishes the technology theme. A restrained red accent, floating navigation, and a visible process section create structure around a broad service offering.
outcome: Brand presence, service discovery, and a clear first point of contact.
label: Website design
imageAlt: DevsTree website displayed inside a front-facing desktop monitor.

title: EasyProps — A clearer way home.
summary: A property-discovery interface built around useful search, scannable listings, and an easier first step.
idea: Make a large property offering easier to approach by putting location, property type, and search at the centre of the experience.
direction: Indigo navigation anchors the page while a prominent search module, illustrated property categories, and consistent listing cards give visitors several clear ways to browse.
outcome: Search clarity, comparable property information, and organised listing discovery.
label: Website design
imageAlt: EasyProps website displayed inside a front-facing desktop monitor.

title: Mint & Oak — Everyday essentials. A little personality.
summary: An expressive storefront where product photography, category navigation, and brand storytelling work together.
idea: Give everyday products a distinctive brand presence while keeping the path into browsing and shopping easy to recognise.
direction: A moody photographic hero pairs bold product messaging with green accents. Clear product categories, a visible shop action, and a lighter brand-story section balance atmosphere with usability.
outcome: Product discovery, editorial brand character, and a clear invitation to shop.
label: Website design
imageAlt: Mint & Oak website displayed inside a front-facing desktop monitor.

title: Muss Montessori — A confident first step for parents.
summary: A warm school website that pairs playful character with clear information for families.
idea: Help families get a feel for the school, understand its educational approach, and find the next step towards a visit or admission.
direction: Blue accents, open layouts, playful illustrations, and children’s photography set an approachable tone. Programme navigation and prominent tour and enrolment actions keep useful information close.
outcome: An approachable school identity, clear parent navigation, and visible admission actions.
label: Website design
imageAlt: Muss Montessori website displayed inside a front-facing desktop monitor.

title: HYYPP — Where brands meet their next collaborators.
summary: A distinctive influencer-platform landing page that introduces the proposition with clarity and energy.
idea: Explain the connection between brands and creators quickly, then give visitors a clear route to exploring collaboration or the app.
direction: A dark canvas and gold type create a distinctive identity. Product imagery, social-platform cues, app-store links, and a strong opening proposition introduce the platform without a dense interface.
outcome: Proposition clarity, creator-brand positioning, and an engaging product introduction.
label: Website design
imageAlt: HYYPP website displayed inside a front-facing desktop monitor.

title: Mississauga Convention Centre — An invitation to celebrate.
summary: An elegant venue website that turns atmosphere, space, and practical details into a considered introduction.
idea: Help visitors picture an event at the venue while giving them useful information and an obvious way to explore further.
direction: Large event photography, generous serif typography, warm ivory, and muted gold create a premium tone. Event navigation and structured venue facts balance emotion with practical information.
outcome: Atmosphere, venue discovery, and a clear route towards an event enquiry.
label: Website design
imageAlt: Mississauga Convention Centre website displayed inside a front-facing desktop monitor.

title: Dawdle — The journey starts with possibility.
summary: A lively travel website that makes discovery feel inviting, organised, and full of character.
idea: Introduce the travel brand with a sense of possibility while keeping destinations, trip styles, and further discovery easy to find.
direction: Bright travel imagery, orange luggage, illustrated details, and green calls to action give the page energy. Clear navigation and alternating content sections keep the story easy to follow.
outcome: Travel inspiration, readable brand storytelling, and approachable destination discovery.
label: Website design
imageAlt: Dawdle website displayed inside a front-facing desktop monitor.

title: SUTRAAai — Complex services. A clear introduction.
summary: A software-services website with a confident visual identity and a structured introduction to its offering.
idea: Make a broad software-development proposition easier to understand and give prospective partners clear routes into the company’s services.
direction: A low-poly character and blue accents introduce the technology theme. A structured service menu, strong headline hierarchy, and a visible meeting action support a clear business-facing presentation.
outcome: Service discovery, confident positioning, and a visible next step for prospective partners.
label: Website design
imageAlt: SUTRAAai website displayed inside a front-facing desktop monitor.

title: Pride of Africa — Culture at the heart of the brand.
summary: A rich, illustrated website that connects cultural character with shopping and service discovery.
idea: Bring the brand’s cultural identity into the first impression while making its retail and business-service paths easy to recognise.
direction: Warm ochre, cultural patterning, and an expressive illustration give the page a strong identity. Distinct shopping and consultation actions lead into a clearly grouped business-services section.
outcome: Cultural identity, distinct user journeys, and a memorable brand introduction.
label: Website design
imageAlt: Pride of Africa website displayed inside a front-facing desktop monitor.

title: Cuu Long Fish — A business story with deeper roots.
summary: A corporate website that uses place, product, and clear navigation to introduce an aquaculture business.
idea: Give visitors a clear introduction to the company and an organised way to explore products, company information, and contact options.
direction: A wide aquatic landscape grounds the brand in its industry. Indigo navigation, a prominent company headline, and a structured introduction establish a clear corporate information hierarchy.
outcome: Company positioning, industry context, and organised product and information discovery.
label: Website design
imageAlt: Cuu Long Fish website displayed inside a front-facing desktop monitor.

title: FairPlay Giveaways — Excitement with a clear next step.
summary: A bold promotional website that pairs an energetic campaign hero with visible entry and membership information.
idea: Make the promotional offer easy to understand while keeping entry actions, membership information, and supporting details visible.
direction: High-contrast campaign typography, gold and blue accents, and a prominent entry action make the offer easy to scan. Structured information cards introduce the platform below the hero.
outcome: Campaign clarity, visible participation actions, and a structured platform introduction.
label: Website design
imageAlt: FairPlay Giveaways website displayed inside a front-facing desktop monitor.
